description: Look up the shipping zone for an origin and a destination ZIP prefix in the carrier zone chart YOU send. Carriers publish zones as rows 'from this origin 3-digit ZIP prefix, destination prefixes 010 to 017 are zone 7'. Send origin_zip (3 digits, or 5 of which the first 3 count), the chart rows (origin, from, to, zone; 'to' left out means one prefix) and destination (one) or destinations (up to 200; a 5-digit ZIP uses its first 3 digits). Get back the zone and the chart row it came from for each destination, or 'not_in_chart'. Refuses a chart with overlapping rows that give different zones. No live rates, no carrier data: the zones are exactly what your chart says. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/shipping-zone-lookup). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

chart.description: Zone chart rows from the carrier (up to 200 per call; send a longer chart's rows for this origin only).

from.description: First destination prefix of the range.

origin.description: Origin ZIP prefix this row is for.

to.description: Last destination prefix of the range (inclusive); leave out for a single prefix.

zone.description: Zone as the chart writes it, for example 7 or 08.

destination.description: One destination ZIP (3 digits, or 5 of which the first 3 count).

destinations.description: Up to 200 destination ZIPs to look up in one call.

origin_zip.description: Origin ZIP: 3 digits, or 5 digits (the first 3 are used).

name: shipping_zone_lookup
title: Shipping Zone by ZIP Prefix
